name: Decline Crunch
instructions: Secure your feet on a decline bench and lie back with arms crossed on your chest.
Curl your torso up, bringing your ribs toward your pelvis.
Pause for a moment at the top.
Lower slowly until your shoulder blades are near the bench.
longevityNotes: A strong, stable core protects the spine in every other movement and makes daily tasks — bending, twisting, reaching — safer. Core endurance matters more than core power.
overview: A crunch on a decline bench that increases the range and resistance on the abs.
